description: Per-residue conservation of BchJ computed from 1000 Foldseek AFDB50 structural alignments; tests conservation of the candidate Cys3 metal site and aromatic pocket
code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, re
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

seq=open("out/bchj_P26169.fasta").read().split("\n")[1]
L=len(seq)
res=json.load(open("out/foldseek_results.json"))
afdb=[]
for db in res['results']:
    if db['db']!='afdb50': continue
    al = db['alignments'][0] if isinstance(db['alignments'][0],list) else db['alignments']
    afdb=al
print("afdb50 hits:", len(afdb))
# keep real homologs: exclude self, require alignment covering >=60% of BchJ
cols=[Counter() for _ in range(L+1)]
used=0; names=[]
for h in afdb:
    if h['target'].startswith('AF-P26169'): continue
    cov=(h['qEndPos']-h['qStartPos']+1)/L
    if cov<0.6: continue
    used+=1; names.append((h['target'], h.get('taxName'), h['seqId'], h['eval']))
    qi=h['qStartPos']-1
    for a,b in zip(h['qAln'], h['dbAln']):
        if a!='-':
            qi+=1
            cols[qi][b]+=1   # b may be '-'
print("homolog alignments used:", used)

rows=[]
for i in range(1,L+1):
    c=cols[i]; n=sum(c.values())
    if n==0: rows.append((i,seq[i-1],0,np.nan,np.nan,"")); continue
    ident=c[seq[i-1]]/n
    gap=c['-']/n
    aa={k:v for k,v in c.items() if k!='-'}
    tot=sum(aa.values())
    ent=-sum((v/tot)*np.log2(v/tot) for v in aa.values()) if tot else np.nan
    top="".join(f"{k}{100*v/tot:.0f} " for k,v in sorted(aa.items(), key=lambda x:-x[1])[:3])
    rows.append((i,seq[i-1],n,ident,gap,ent,top))
cons=pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["pos","aa","n","identity","gapfrac","entropy","top3"])
cons.to_csv("out/bchj_conservation_profile.csv", index=False)

focus=[60,159,185,193,122,162,124,126,142,166,170,161,89,119,144,195,182,64,30]
print("\n--- Conservation at residues of interest (fraction of %d homologs with the same residue) ---"%used)
print(cons[cons.pos.isin(focus)].sort_values('identity',ascending=False).to_string(index=False))

print("\n--- Top 25 most conserved positions ---")
print(cons.sort_values('identity',ascending=False).head(25).to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,6.5),sharex=True,height_ratios=[2,1])
ax[0].bar(cons.pos, cons.identity, color="#4c78a8", width=1.0)
for p,c in [(159,'#e45756'),(185,'#e45756'),(193,'#e45756')]:
    ax[0].axvline(p, color=c, lw=1.2, ls='--')
for p in [124,126,142,162,166,170]:
    ax[0].axvline(p, color="#f58518", lw=0.8, ls=':')
ax[0].set_ylabel("fraction identical to BchJ")
ax[0].set_title("Residue conservation of R. capsulatus BchJ across %d structural homologs (Foldseek AFDB50)\nred dashed: candidate Cys3 metal site (C159, C185, C193); orange dotted: aromatic pocket lining"%used)
ax[1].plot(cons.pos, cons.entropy, color="#54a24b", lw=0.9)
ax[1].set_ylabel("Shannon entropy (bits)"); ax[1].set_xlabel("BchJ residue position")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
